generate_copt_file: generate a Starlark or CMake copt file from COPT_VARS using the given style object
copt_list: build a formatted copt list string for a given variable name and argument list with a style
CMakeStyle: create a CMakeStyle object to format Abseil compile options as CMake list(APPEND) syntax
StarlarkStyle: create a StarlarkStyle object to format Abseil compile options as Starlark list assignment syntax
main: run the generate_copts script to produce both Starlark and CMake copt config files
